name: youtube
prompt: open https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw in {browser}, let it play muted for a few seconds, then pause it and leave it open for me
result: the video title, its channel, paused=<true|false> muted=<true|false>

name: wikipedia
prompt: open wikipedia in {browser}, use its search box to find the article on Ada Lovelace and tell me when she was born
result: her date of birth exactly as the article states it

name: hackernews
prompt: open hacker news in {browser}, click More at the bottom of the page twice and tell me the first story on that page
result: the first story's rank number as rank=<n> and its title

name: github
prompt: open the microsoft/playwright repo on github in {browser}, go to its latest release and tell me what it is
result: the latest release's tag as tag=<tag> and its date

name: mdn
prompt: search MDN in {browser} for Array.prototype.flatMap and tell me what it returns
result: the method's name and, in one sentence, what it returns

name: form
prompt: fill out the pizza order form at https://httpbin.org/forms/post in {browser}: customer name Alex Doe, telephone 555-0100, email alex@example.com, size medium, toppings bacon and cheese, delivery time 19:30, comments "ring twice". then submit it and tell me what the server got
result: the name and size the server echoed back, as custname=<name> size=<size>
